description: This file defines classes and functions for handling file operations within the Litellm project, specifically tailored for Google Vertex AI integration. It includes configuration classes, content transformation utilities, and methods for file management such as uploading, URL generation, and response parsing.

classes.name: VertexAIJsonlFilesTransformation
